text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock D and Stock B at gains felt rewarding, but I should base sales on my portfolio plan rather than the comfort of locking in profits.","My account’s ups and downs—and the prices I’ve seen so far—don’t predict next month, so I should avoid reacting to short-term moves.","Because losses feel especially painful and I check my account often, I should pause before trading and keep decisions focused on risk, diversification, and my long-term plan."]}
